name: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited
summary: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited manufactures and sells asbestos free friction materials in India and internationally. The company offers drum brake linings, disc and N-level pads, rubber-based CV linings, high-copper woven clutch facings, and friction pads, as well as body and structural parts from carbon fibre composite materials. Its products are used in commercial vehicles, passenger cars, agricultural tractors, railways, and two wheelers. The company also exports its products to approximately 60 countries. Sundaram Brake Linings Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
